title: Lifetime stats HUD + deferred S153 hooks (self-death + chain detection)
notes: Closes the three S153 deferrals from GDP-2026-05-27-009: the deathsByOwnBomb hook, the chainReactionsTriggered + maxChainLength hook, and the ?showLifetime=true HUD line. All wired through the existing snapshot-loop diff pattern in bootstrap.ts — no new ECS systems, no new protocol messages.

Attribution is intentionally tight: self-death requires both the local-player alive→false transition AND ≥ 1 own-bomb that disappeared this frame (so a chained-from-bot-bomb death doesn't get attributed). Chain-reaction count is the total bombs that vanished this frame when ≥ 2 — works for both fuse-chain and remote-detonate-chain detonations.

stories.title: bootstrap.ts: detect local self-death via own-bomb-disappear + alive-flip diff
stories.summary: examples/kaboom-crew/bootstrap.ts — per-frame snapshot loop tracks prevAlive + prevOwnBombIds (filtered to ownerId === 'player.1'). When alive flips true → false AND ≥ 1 prevOwnBombId disappeared this frame, call profileStore.recordSelfDeath(). Tight attribution — chained-from-bot deaths don't count.
verification: acceptance: bootstrap.ts wires prevAlive + prevOwnBombIds tracking; recordSelfDeath fires once on the alive-flip frame when an own bomb disappeared simultaneously.

stories.title: bootstrap.ts: detect chain reactions via all-bomb-disappear count
stories.summary: examples/kaboom-crew/bootstrap.ts — per-frame snapshot tracks prevAllBombIds. Each frame counts how many bombs disappeared (prev set minus current set). When count ≥ 2, call profileStore.recordChain(count). Works uniformly for fuse-chain + remote-detonate-chain detonations.
verification: acceptance: bootstrap.ts wires prevAllBombIds tracking; recordChain fires with the disappeared-count when ≥ 2 in a single frame.

stories.title: kaboom.lifetime-hud widget — opt-in via ?showLifetime=true
stories.summary: examples/kaboom-crew/bootstrap.ts — register a new HUD widget keyed by LIFETIME_HUD_ID in the bottomLeft slot. Mounted only when URL has `?showLifetime=true` (default off — preserves the clean HUD for new players). Renders a 4-line block (LIFETIME header + matches W/M + rounds W/L/D/total + self-kills/max-chain) using cream text at 85 % opacity. Per-frame update pushes the profile store's lifetimeStats into the widget so counters tick live.
verification: acceptance: bootstrap.ts adds the LIFETIME_HUD_ID widget gated on `?showLifetime=true`; when on, the widget renders the 4-line stats block and updates each frame from profileStore.get().lifetimeStats.
